# markdown-formatter

Formats markdown files according to best practices and common style guidelines. Use when cleaning up markdown documentation, ensuring consistent formatting, or standardising README files.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 2.2.1
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r markdown-formatter ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r markdown-formatter .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `resources/checklist.txt`
- `resources/code-emphasis.md`
- `resources/examples.md`
- `resources/headers-hierarchy.md`
- `resources/links-images.md`
- `resources/lists-nesting.md`
- `resources/spacing-tables.md`
- `resources/style-guide.md`
- `scripts/validate-markdown.sh`

## Part of a larger set

One of the Developer environment skills (`claude-skills-dev-environment`). See the [group's list](../../README.md),
or every group in [claude-skills](https://github.com/markpitt/claude-skills).
